sections.title: First Fighters Guild Visit
sections.objective: Open Fighters Guild access and decide whether to take its first work.
sections.preparation: Arrive with repaired equipment and room for practical supplies.

walkthroughBlocks.title: Open the guild while you are already in town
walkthroughBlocks.text: When your route brings you to a Fighters Guild hall, introduce yourself and ask about joining before accepting every available job. Membership gives a combat-focused character a useful home base; once you have access, review the first assignment, buy or store supplies if needed, and add it to the route only when it matches your current travel plans.

steps.text: Ask about joining the Fighters Guild.
Review the first available Fighters Guild job before accepting it.
